S12 kill-switch stage cannot share the scenario file or the run

label: 006 depends on 065 in two separable halves - the scenario format and validator from 001-scenario-contract, the executing runner from 002-conversation-runner - yet gates on both at once in T001; only the run tasks need 002.

The runner turn schema (id, send-or-action, delay_ms, timeout_ms, questions, mandatory check) is the operative constraint on 006 stage authoring: five per-stage observables collapse into one shell exit status, and a turn without check is invalid.

A turn check runs as bash -c in the project with CONVERSATION_REPO_ROOT, CONVERSATION_RUN_DIR and CONVERSATION_TURN_DIR set, and the first failed turn ends that runtime run, so 006 gets per-turn granularity, not per-observable.

065 REQ-013 anticipates 006 needs item for item (process question that leaves no trace, mid-run and final saves, restart or compaction, kill-switch run, per-turn state copies, results matrix), and the runtime id set matches 006 five matrix rows exactly; this part of the contract is right.

The scratch-project design matches the runner guard: 006 uses mktemp -d outside the repository, symlinks only hooks, bin and system-spec-kit, and keeps .skilled/skills/.state a real directory, which is exactly what 065 refuses to accept alternatives to.

Hard conflict: 006 stage S12 needs a second project and SYSTEM_DECISION_CAPTURE_DISABLED=1, but the format allows one top-level env, the runner takes one --scenario and one --scratch per invocation, and a second conversation block is invalid. S12 must become a second scenario file plus a second invocation, which breaks 006 REQ-001 and AC-001 one-file 13-row commitment.

The verdict vocabulary is unreconciled: 065 fixes PASS, FAIL or SKIP only and states the mapping is 043/006 to make, while 043/006 still requires PASS, FAIL, DEVIATION or N/A in four places with no mapping anywhere. A conforming runner never emits two of the four marks its consumer acceptance criterion demands.

checkpoints.tsv has no producer: 065 per-runtime evidence is result.json, actions.jsonl, raw-pane.log, setup.log, both snapshots, matrix.md and per turn screen.txt, question-N.txt and check.txt, with no per-stage row file. 006 T007, AC-005 and SC-001 all gate on 13 rows of it while the plan says the runner runs the checkpoint and saves the pane.

S0 sits outside the turn model: the runner guard requires an already-prepared scratch project and check runs only after a settled turn, so 006 S0 (build the project, record baselines) is a pre-runner step belonging to T003 and its row can never come from the run.

S8 and S9 are written as typed human keystrokes (/compact, /exit plus claude --continue) where the turn schema provides action compact and action restart, and typing /exit as send would surface as SUBJECT_EXITED; 006 NFR-R02 DEVIATION retry has no runner mechanism because the first failed turn ends the run.

006 re-implements the runner repository guard with a weaker flag set: 065 snapshots git status --porcelain --ignored while 006 uses git status --short without --ignored, so the gitignored decision-capture state directory 006 most needs to protect is invisible to its own check.

006 per-turn nudge-line assertions depend on whether screen.txt is written before or after a turn check runs, which 065 does not state; the count assertions are safe through CONVERSATION_REPO_ROOT, and the confirming artifact is the ordering in run-conversation-scenario.cjs, which does not exist yet. Inferred.

The dependency is acyclic and 006 is not on 065 critical path: 065 handoff criterion is its own MTP-007 run on Claude Code and it names 043/006 as first consumer not as proof, so the cost of the ordering is format risk rather than deadlock.
A consumer acceptance criterion that counts rows or names verdict marks must be satisfiable from the provider enumerated evidence contract; otherwise the consumer invents a producer it does not own.
A scenario file holds at most one conversation block and one top-level env, so any stage needing a different project or environment cannot share that file.
006 acceptance-criteria itself states no live run has happened and the 065 runner does not exist yet
